slug: 2025-12-12 Personal data and digital rights in Togo - HAAC and IPDCP seal institutional cooperation accord

facts.fact: Africa Cybersecurity Mag, citing the IPDCP, reports the Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP) acting as a signatory to an institutional cooperation accord with the broadcast regulator HAAC on 10 December 2025.
